say:1:1130332001:1.text: His son is called Kojin, a stout young warrior with great potential.
say:1:1130332001:1.source_cn: 他的儿子叫做库金，是一个拥有健壮体魄的年轻人。
say:1:1130332001:1.male: His son is called Kojin, a stout young warrior with great potential.
say:1:1130332001:1.female: His son is called Kojin, a stout young warrior with great potential.

say:2:1130332002:1.text: He follows closely in his father's footsteps and will grow into the strongest warrior we've ever seen!
say:2:1130332002:1.source_cn: 他十分认同自己的父亲并且崇拜他，他也会成长为最强的勇士！
say:2:1130332002:1.male: He follows closely in his father's footsteps and will grow into the strongest warrior we've ever seen!
say:2:1130332002:1.female: He follows closely in his father's footsteps and will grow into the strongest warrior we've ever seen!
